title: SB27 (2021 Regular): Public Safety - Permit to Carry, Wear, or Transport a Handgun - Qualifications

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2021RS/bills/sb/sb0027f.pdf)
provenance.note: Version read: first reader (bill as filed); no vote recorded, so no later amendments to account for.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-306(a)): Subject to subsection (c) of this section, the Secretary shall issue a permit within a reasonable time to a person who the Secretary finds:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-306(a)(6)): based on an investigation: (i) has not exhibited a propensity for violence or instability that may reasonably render the person’s possession of a handgun a danger to the person or to another; and (ii) has good and substantial reason to wear, carry, or transport a handgun, such as PERSONAL PROTECTION, SELF–DEFENSE, OR a finding that the permit is necessary as a reasonable precaution against apprehended danger.
